mechanism: Opposing CNS effects with alprazolam (GABAergic depressant) and lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic stimulant) create pharmacodynamic conflict and increased cardiovascular strain; potential for reduced efficacy of both agents.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful clinical monitoring and dose adjustment; if combination necessary, monitor for tachycardia, hypertension, anxiety exacerbation, and reduced therapeutic effect of either drug.
